title: Comte and Kenyan Roasted Pasta
description: A creamy pasta dish with roasted comte and kenyan spices, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This recipe is a fusion of French and African flavors.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the Kenyan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted red peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the Comte cheese until melted and creamy.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a baking dish and top with additional Comte cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
